# Scientific-owner direction after EL-F10

Date: `2026-09-04`

EL-F10 exactly explained the large direct a1400 map response from removing
UID 4460, scan 5 in iteration 5. The response is a modest, spatially varying
signed JINC share multiplied by an extreme processed-signal contrast. The
result is exact for this observation, detector, scan, and iteration, but it

The manager recommended opening EL-F11 as a prospective influence study. Its

The scientific owner replied:

This is direction to prepare the exact EL-F11 owner-review packet. It is not
